description: This file defines an Android Activity class named DigitalWatchFaceWearableConfigActivity, which functions as the watch-side configuration interface for a digital watch face. It provides a UI for setting the background color by selecting from a list of colors and communicates changes via the Google API client to the associated digital watch face service.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceWearableConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for configuring watch face settings on a wearable device, including color selection.

classes.name: ColorListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying color options in the wearable list view.

classes.name: ColorItem
classes.description: Custom view representing a color option with animated focus effects.

classes.name: ColorItemViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for the ColorItem in the list.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and connects to GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity stops.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a color option, updates configuration, and finishes activity.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: No operation; placeholder for handling clicks outside list items.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Responds to scroll events; currently not implemented.

methods.name: onAbsoluteScrollChange
methods.description: Animates header translation based on scroll.

methods.name: onScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Handles scroll state changes; currently not implemented.

methods.name: onCentralPositionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the centered item; currently not implemented.

methods.name: updateConfigDataItem
methods.description: Sends the selected background color to the connected watch face via DataMap.
